title: Orbs summoned to hover over Jay Anderson's house

tellings.quote: a meditative state and made requests for something to turn up and float down and hover above my house

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on the show, says he went into a meditative state and asked for something to appear, float down and hover over his house, and that glowing balls of light did. He tells it himself, giving no date. If true, it would mean these lights can be called by the mind.
